faq.q: Are French Bulldogs easy to train?
faq.a: They are smart and people-focused, but the AKC warns they can be stubborn and may need more training than other breeds. Short sessions and rewards they really want work best.

faq.q: At what age should I start training my French Bulldog puppy?
faq.a: As soon as your puppy comes home, usually at around 8 weeks. Keep sessions to 5 to 10 minutes and focus on one thing at a time.

faq.q: How do I train my French Bulldog not to bite?
faq.a: When your puppy mouths hands or clothes, pause play for a few seconds and offer a chew toy, then praise your puppy for using it. Never hit or hold the muzzle shut, because that teaches fear of hands.

faq.q: Should a French Bulldog wear a collar or a harness?
faq.a: A harness. Neck pressure can make breathing harder for a flat-faced dog, and a study found collar pressure raised pressure inside the eye while a harness did not.

faq.q: Do French Bulldogs need a firm or alpha approach?
faq.a: No. Veterinary behaviorists at AVSAB advise against dominance-based training and recommend reward-based methods for every dog, because punishment increases fear and can lead to aggression.
